what: Proposed `phase_coder_select` re-declares `local codex_available=false` / `local cursor_available=false` and gates on nonexistent `codex_available_from_infra` / `cursor_available_from_infra` while the comment says to reuse `phase_infra` globals
scenario_or_breakage: Function-local names shadow module globals from `phase_infra`; the bogus `*_from_infra` test never passes, so implicit/explicit routing always sees unavailable externals and falls through to Claude or mis-bails
suggested_fix: Remove the local availability block (plan lines 50–53); use only `codex_available` / `cursor_available` set in `phase_infra` (scripts/implement-bootstrap.sh:479-487) for routing; keep the four-key re-read solely for tri-state `*_BINARY_FOUND` classification
